items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Years ago I remember Ozzie Nelson, the band leader, and when they had bands on the stage and in his first number he would go out and stand on his head

ctx.x: tainment. I remember some critic made a remark, one of the reasons why the musicians weren't getting the appreciation or the interest that they thought they should have got is because there is no showmanship there. And of course they were making a comparison. This was when business was bad and they couldn't figure out why. But Cab Calloway was pulling along strongly because Cab was a showman.
